g.text: 1. User must be able to view cars.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. User must be able to search cars based on filters and names.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. User must be able to purchase a car if quantity > 0 (At the time of purchase).

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Only admin users must be allowed to add a car in the inventory.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Only admin users must be allowed to delete a car from the inventory.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. Only admin users must be allowed to update car details.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 7. Admin users must be provided with charts for statistics (self-given req)

g.text: 1. VALIDATES IF THE REQUEST IS CORRECT.
3. CALLS THE REPO TO SAVE USER DETAILS
1. CREATES A TRANSACTION TO CREATE A USER
AND ENTER THE REFRESH TOKEN IN U_R_T TABLE
2. RETURNS THE USER DETAIL ON SUCCESS
1. VALIDATES IF THE REQUEST IS CORRECT.
3. CALLS THE REPO TO DELETE PREV REFRESH TOKEN
1. CHECKS THE ORIGIN OF THE REQUEST
2. IF THE ORIGIN IS FRONTEND -> ALLOWS
2. CALL THE REPOSITORY TO ROTATE REFRESH TOKEN
1. HOLD TRANSACTION FOR UPDATING THE R-TKN
